name: Bitwise
summary: Bitwise is a San Francisco-based crypto asset manager serving advisers, institutions, and wealth platforms through ETFs, separately managed accounts, private funds, and staking strategies.
overview: Bitwise is a crypto-specialist asset manager whose product set spans exchange-traded products, separately managed accounts, private funds, and onchain strategies. Its February 2025 equity raise followed rapid growth in client assets, though the company did not disclose a financing valuation.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Bitwise announced the raise, led by Electric Capital, without a valuation.

bull_case: A growing institutional channel and a broad product catalogue can make Bitwise a durable distribution platform as digital assets mature as an asset class.
bear_case: Fee pressure, crypto-market cyclicality, and regulation can quickly change asset flows and economics for specialist managers.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: A crypto-specialist asset manager serving institutional and wealth-management clients.

metrics.label: Latest valuation
metrics.note: Not announced with the February 2025 equity raise

metrics.label: Client assets
metrics.note: Reported by Bitwise at the February 2025 financing announcement

company: Bitwise builds investment products for advisers, institutions, family offices, and wealth platforms seeking crypto exposure. The firm said its 2025 equity raise would support its beta, alpha, and onchain businesses.

The company is a useful read-through on whether crypto allocation is becoming a durable institutional product category rather than a retail-led trading cycle. Its financing supports the balance sheet, but it did not establish a public valuation benchmark.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Bitwise sits at the intersection of private fintech infrastructure and public-market crypto access. Asset flows and product adoption can signal how institutional demand for digital assets is evolving.

changed.text: Bitwise announced a $70M equity raise led by Electric Capital.

takeaways: The February 2025 raise provides a confirmed capital event but not a valuation benchmark.
Distribution to advisers and institutions is central to Bitwise's investment case.
Crypto asset prices, regulation, and fee competition remain material risks.
